title: Chouthi Manzil Ka Raaz
logline: An ordinary IT worker moves into a Mumbai flat where every night at 3 AM, an exact duplicate of his living room lights up on the floor above.
setting: A slightly cramped 1BHK rented flat in a suburban Mumbai housing society.

cast.Mehul: 27 years old, tired brown eyes, messy black hair, wearing a faded blue cotton t-shirt, holding a cracked black smartphone.
cast.Vikrant: 27 years old, sharp features, neat black hair, wearing Mehul's faded blue cotton t-shirt, holding Mehul's cracked black smartphone.
cast.Raghav: 27 years old, Mehul's college friend and neighbour, cheerful round face, short curly hair, light stubble, mustard hoodie, always carries a steel water bottle
cast.Sharma ji: 58 years old, weathered face with deep laugh lines, thick graying mustache, receding salt-and-pepper hair tied in a small knot at the back, khaki watchman uniform with brass buttons and a faded society badge, always carries a wooden lathi with a red cloth wrapped around its handle

parts.title: Batti Upar Wali
parts.beats: Mehul shifts into flat 302 of Orchid Towers on a rainy Tuesday night. At exactly 3:00 AM, he wakes up to a bright yellow glow spilling onto his ceiling from the balcony above. He looks up and realizes the apartment directly overhead, flat 402, has been sealed with a permanent iron padlock for years. Yet, through the window, he sees a glowing study lamp moving on its own.
parts.cliffhanger: Mehul hears a soft knock from inside the locked flat above him, followed by the distinct sound of a pen scratching on paper.

parts.title: Chabi Wala
parts.beats: The next morning, Mehul questions Sharma ji, the society watchman, about the fourth-floor flat. Sharma ji turns pale and drops his chai glass, swearing flat 402 has been empty since the original owner vanished in 2018. Mehul refuses to drop it and checks the electricity meter box downstairs in the basement. He discovers that meter number 402 is showing high active power consumption right at this moment. Mehul's friend Raghav is with him and helps (keeps the mood human, a little humour).
parts.cliffhanger: Mehul opens meter box 402 and finds a fresh note inside with his exact name and current mobile number written in red ink.

parts.title: Laal Siyahi
parts.beats: Shaken, Mehul calls the number written on the note, but it rings out to his own phone, which is sitting in his pocket. He rushes back upstairs and notices a trail of fresh red ink drops on his living room floor, leading directly from his front door toward the empty balcony. He follows the drops and finds a single red fountain pen resting on his outdoor ledge. Mehul's friend Raghav is with him and helps (keeps the mood human, a little humour).
parts.cliffhanger: Mehul picks up the pen and realizes it is leaking, and the ink on his fingers spells out a warning: 'Don't look in the mirror'.

parts.title: Aaina
parts.beats: Ignoring the warning, Mehul stands in front of his bathroom mirror to wash the ink off his hands. In the reflection, he sees the hallway light behind him flicker and turn off, though he is alone in the flat. When he turns around, the hallway is empty, but the mirror reflection shows a tall, faceless silhouette standing right behind where he was just sitting. Mehul's friend Raghav is with him and helps (keeps the mood human, a little humour).
parts.cliffhanger: The silhouette in the mirror slowly raises its hand and points a finger directly at Mehul's bedroom door.

parts.title: Band Kamra
parts.beats: Mehul slowly pushes open his bedroom door, bracing himself for the worst. Inside, his bed is neatly made, but his laptop is open on the desk, playing a live CCTV feed of flat 402's living room. On the screen, he watches himself sleeping in his bed last night, but the timestamp on the video says the recording happened in October 2018—five years before he even rented this flat. Mehul's friend Raghav is with him and helps (keeps the mood human, a little humour).
parts.cliffhanger: On the laptop screen, a hand reaches out from under Mehul's bed in the video and grabs his ankle.

parts.title: Purana Kirayedar
parts.beats: Panicking, Mehul dives to the floor and looks under his bed, finding a box covered in thick dust. He opens it to reveal old rent receipts, a college ID card, and a diary belonging to a man named Vikrant who looked identical to him. The diary entries stop abruptly on November 12, 2018, with the words: 'He is coming down the stairs tonight.'
parts.cliffhanger: A heavy, dragging footstep echoes loudly on the ceiling right above Mehul's head, moving step by step toward his balcony.

parts.title: Chhat Ka Raasta
parts.beats: Determined to face whatever is up there, Mehul takes the master keys he stole from Sharma ji's desk and climbs the stairwell to the fourth floor. The heavy iron padlock on flat 402 is rusted shut, but the wooden door is unlocked and ajar. He pushes it open to find a room completely barren of furniture, except for a single wooden chair placed in the center facing a wall.
parts.cliffhanger: As Mehul steps inside, the heavy wooden door slams shut behind him with a loud click, and the lock slides into place from the outside.

parts.title: Deewar Ke Us Paar
parts.beats: Trapped, Mehul inspects the room and discovers that the wall facing the chair is actually a massive two-way mirror. He wipes the dust off the glass and peers through into the adjoining room. To his absolute horror, he sees his own flat 302 downstairs—and standing in his living room is Vikrant, alive, wearing Mehul's own blue t-shirt, looking directly up through the floor at him.
parts.cliffhanger: Vikrant picks up a phone and dials, and a second later, Mehul's own phone in his pocket begins to ring.

parts.title: Sachaai
parts.beats: Mehul answers the phone with shaking hands. Vikrant's voice whispers through the speaker: 'Every five years, the building takes a new tenant to trap the old one. You paid the rent, Mehul. Now you are the ghost upstairs.' Downstairs in the mirror, Mehul watches Vikrant walk out of the flat 302 front door, lock it from the outside, and throw the keys into the lift shaft.
parts.cliffhanger: Heavy footsteps ascend the stairs toward flat 402, and a key turns in the outside lock with a metallic click.

parts.title: Naya Shikar
parts.beats: The door of flat 402 swings open, and a new, terrified young man with luggage enters the room, looking around nervously. Mehul, now fading into a transparent silhouette, stands quietly in the dark corner holding a red fountain pen. He offers a weak, welcoming smile to the newcomer as the clock strikes 3:00 AM.
parts.cliffhanger: Har roz ek nayi kahani... aur agli baari aapki hai.

owner_names: Owner 18 Nov: hero Mehul, friend Raghav for this story; later stories rotate his friends; villains are made-up names.
